title: Routing Rules
description: Rewrite request paths before they are forwarded upstream. Each rule is a regex pattern and a rewrite template. Reference capture groups with <code1>$1</code1>, <code2>$2</code2>, and so on. Rules are evaluated in order; the first match wins.
empty: No routing rules configured. Requests are forwarded upstream unchanged.
bothRequired: Both pattern and rewrite target are required.
invalidPattern: Path pattern is not a valid regular expression.
